title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roquan Smith (foot) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Roquan Smith was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Smith is on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adam Randall (neck) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Adam Randall was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Randall had his practice window opened last week. He'll have a chance to be activated for Thursday's game against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vega Ioane (knee) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Vega Ioane was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Ioane is on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justice Hill (groin) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Justice Hill was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hill will remain in his change-of-pace role behind Derrick Henry for Thursday's game against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger/ribs) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hendrickson is on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Fagnano (ankle) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Joe Fagnano was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Fagnano was named the starter for Thursday's game against the Jaguars. He will be making his first career start.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Calais Campbell (rest) misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: Calais Campbell did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Campbell has gotten two straight rest days. He should be back at practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (foot) officially misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Tuten opens the week with back-to-back missed practices. His status will need to be monitored closely on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited in practice Tuesday
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Rodriguez is on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Ravens. He could be in line for an expanded role with Bhayshul Tuten still sidelined from practice on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) limited in practice Tuesday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Meyers is on track to be good to go. He'll remain a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Samson Ebukam (hamstring) placed on IR
items.desc: The Falcons placed DL Samson Ebukam on injured reserve.
items.impact: Ebukam was already ruled out for Week 9. He will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Horsley released by Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals released defensive lineman Cam Horsley from the practice squad.
items.impact: Horsley will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Yeboah placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed TE Kenny Yeboah on injured reserve.
items.impact: Yeboah had been elevated for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rivaldo Fairweather re-signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals re-signed veteran tight end Rivaldo Fairweather to the practice squad.
items.impact: Fairweather will add depth in the tight end room for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harrison Wallace III signs with Cardinals' active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals signed WR Harrison Wallace III to their active roster.
items.impact: Wallace gets the opportunity with Kendrick Bourne placed on injured reserve. He signed with Arizona as a UDFA.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendrick Bourne (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed WR Kendrick Bourne on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bourne suffered a broken tibia that will end his season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Greg Newsome II signs three-year extension with Giants
items.desc: The Giants and CB Greg Newsome reached agreement on a three-year, $46 million extension.
items.impact: The deal includes $32 million guaranteed. Newsome lands long-term security after signing a one-year contract with the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Robert Henry Jr. claimed off waivers by Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders claimed RB Robert Henry Jr. off waivers.
items.impact: Henry was waived by the Seahawks. He was with Washington as a UDFA earlier this year. He'll add depth in the backfield for the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Loop (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: The Ravens placed kicker Tyler Loop on injured reserve.
items.impact: Loop will be sidelined with a groin injury. Jake Moody will kick for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Gardner-Johnson released by Bills
items.desc: The Bills are releasing safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson.
items.impact: Gardner-Johnson played six games for Buffalo before his suspension. He will seek another opportunity after his suspension is up.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bub Means released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released WR Bub Means.
items.impact: Means was released from the practice squad. He will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Wes Pahl released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released punter Wes Pahl from their practice squad.
items.impact: Pahl will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vershon Lee released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released OG Vershon Lee from their practice squad.
items.impact: Cleveland signed G Austin Blaske as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Coker released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released OT Andrew Coker from their practice squad.
items.impact: Cleveland signed T Xavier Truss as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Truss signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed OT Xavier Truss to their practice squad.
items.impact: Truss will add depth on the offensive line for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Guillory signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed WR Xavier Guillory to their practice squad.
items.impact: Guillory was released by the Ravens in October. He will remain in the AFC North with Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Austin Blaske signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed OG Austin Blaske to their practice squad.
items.impact: Blaske will add depth on the offensive line for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Audric Estime claimed off waivers by Saints
items.desc: The Saints claimed RB Audric Estime off waivers from Cleveland.
items.impact: Estime will add depth in the backfield for New Orleans. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Carlson released by Saints
items.desc: The Saints released kicker Daniel Carlson.
items.impact: New Orleans claimed RB Audric Estime off waivers as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adetomiwa Adebawore signs two-year extension with Colts
items.desc: Colts DL Adetomiwa Adebawore signed a two-year, $35 million extension.
items.impact: Adebawore lands a new deal in the middle of a breakout season. The contract includes a $13 million signing bonus and $22.5 million in new money through 2027.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Commanders placed DL Javon Kinlaw on injured reserve.
items.impact: Kinlaw did not play in Sunday's win over the Eagles. He will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daron Payne placed on IR
items.desc: The Commanders placed DL Daron Payne on injured reserve.
items.impact: Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremy McNichols placed on IR
items.desc: The Commanders placed RB Jeremy McNichols on injured reserve.
items.impact: McNichols suffered the injury in Sunday's win over the Eagles. He will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Keegan released by Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings released OG Trevor Keegan.
items.impact: Keegan has played in seven games this season. He will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Huntley (toe) is IR candidate
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Tyler Huntley is potentially an IR candidate.
items.impact: Huntley is slated to miss extended time with a turf toe injury. Joe Fagnano has been named the Week 9 starter for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Goodlow signs with Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders signed DL Anthony Goodlow to their practice squad.
items.impact: Goodlow will add depth on the defensive line for Las Vegas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) status uncertain
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald did not have an update on the status of Leonard Williams.
items.impact: Williams left Monday's loss against the Bears with a stinger. His status is uncertain heading into Week 9 against the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) hopeful to return in Week 9
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Rashid Shaheed could return in Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Shaheed did not play in Monday's loss against the Bears. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) could return in Week 9
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Uchenna Nwosu could return in Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Nwosu did not play in Monday's loss against the Bears. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) could return in Week 9
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Charles Cross could return in Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Cross did not play in Monday's loss against the Bears. He was given a 1-2 week timetable to return with an ankle sprain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) practices on side Tuesday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips practiced on Tuesday.
items.impact: It was reported on Monday that Phillips was trending in the right direction. He'll have a chance to return in Week 9 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Dillon (ankle) practicing Tuesday
items.desc: AJ Dillon was back practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dillon remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brady Christensen designated to return from IR
items.desc: The Panthers designated OL Brady Christensen for return from IR.
items.impact: Christensen will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins remained sidelined from practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hawkins will likely miss another game on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve.
items.impact: Love suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's win over the Cowboys. He is expected to be sidelined for the next 4-5 weeks. Pending the status of Bam Knight, Tyler Allgeier will figure to return to the lead role in the Cardinals backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lucas Scott released by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens released FB Lucas Scott from the practice squad.
items.impact: Baltimore signed QB Austin Reed to the practice squad as the corresponding move.
